title: Report filtering: select a customer and explain every minute
goal: Reconcile a customer-reference filter against own requests while retaining all other records.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a6; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: The report shows 105 minutes while you expected 180. Check the selected customer before the formula. The same report answers different questions for different filter references. Trace the original numbers and account for every minute; an equal-named empty card checks the boundary.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Work in a new verified copy of your training service. The main Alpha 30/45=75 control and new independent 50/25/15/35/55=180 customer work are different sets. Overall totals include previous work. Nexus saves your note; the standard report and its variants run in external 1C. Do not open unknown EPF/ERF; renaming a variant adds no features.

sections.title: The question determines parameters
paragraphs: The starter report offers a Клиент filter; period/status are not ready-made quick settings. Do not search for absent controls. Selecting a reference answers “Alpha requests”; “closed requests this month” requires a different schema/change, handled in the last lesson.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Follow the scoped native application route; diagrams are not executable browser code.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

Returning and clearing filters preserve records.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Disable Клиент, generate and record T0/count. Retain old documents. Expected: Initial total and document count recorded.
Step 2. Create own Alpha/Beta/service; save 30/45 for Alpha and 15 for Beta with Новая. Record codes/numbers. Expected: Your three requests are saved: two for Alpha and one for Beta.
Step 3. Enable Клиент, select Alpha by card/code, finish settings and generate. Expected: Alpha: two actual requests totaling 75 minutes.

Step 4. Select Beta and generate 1/15. Disable filtering and regenerate overall results: increment 3/90 over T0. Expected: Beta: one request for 15 minutes; disabling the filter adds three requests and 90 minutes relative to the baseline.
Step 5. Record actual codes/numbers, filter state and totals, not just a screenshot of one sum. Expected: Each total links to actual source requests and the chosen customer reference.

sections.title: Resources have units
paragraphs: Create two of your own customers, Учебный A7 — Альфа and Учебный A7 — Бета, one service and three requests: 30 and 45 minutes for Alpha, 15 minutes for Beta. Write down their actual codes and document numbers. First record the existing overall total T0. The new documents add three requests and 90 minutes; older documents remain in the infobase. Alpha filtering must show two requests totaling 75 minutes; Beta filtering must show one request for 15 minutes.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: Two cards have equal names. Must filtering either one give the same total?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. The filter uses a particular reference, not a name string. An empty equal-named card does not acquire another card’s requests. Compare its code and original numbers, then generate the report again.

sections.title: Filters can act at different levels
paragraphs: Количество counts documents and Минуты sums their ДлительностьМинут, not service cost. Choose by card/code: another equal-named customer without requests yields an empty set. Name text is not a reference. Reconcile source numbers and the selected identity before altering any formula.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Empty; the original Alpha requests still exist.
Compare the T0 increment or selected customer without deleting old records.

sections.title: Detect wrong parameters
paragraphs: Use Настройки, locate Клиент, enable its filter, select the own customer, finish settings and click Сформировать. Disabling the filter restores the overall set without deleting records. An empty selection does not mean the entire base is empty. Regenerate for Alpha, Beta and disabled filtering.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your new verified copy continuing A6 locate the earlier independent A5 customer with five requests 50/25/15/35/55. Record numbers and the independent total 180. Generate for this reference, then for the earlier North 105, then return to the first customer and remove the filter. Record the scope of each result; the overall total includes previous work and the A7 control trio. Choose the equal-named Alphas by actual code: the empty reference must give an empty set.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author’s separate training copy continues accepted A6: 9/300. Three 30/45/15 requests are added for the main example; the whole copy is 12/390. The main Alpha 75→80 control uses actual DCS. The new independent customer 180→185 is also checked with a saved variant across three 1C processes. OriginalA6 is unchanged; all 12 identities, A4 note, A5 rows and A6 description persist in the copy. Unknown processors were not executed; period/status support is not implemented.

Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: Two cards have equal names. Must filtering either one give the same total?
options: Yes: the report merges equal names
selfcheck.feedback: No. The filter uses a particular reference, not a name string. An empty equal-named card does not acquire another card’s requests. Compare its code and original numbers, then generate the report again.

selfcheck.prompt: You expected 180 but North 105 is selected. First action?
selfcheck.feedback: Five own numbers give 50+25+15+35+55=180. North has another 105 set, so correcting a wrongly selected reference changes the answer without changing code. Returning to the first customer gives 180 again; removing the filter includes the whole infobase rather than only these five numbers. Alpha with two requests gives 75; another equal-named reference with no requests is empty. Reading leaves document numbers and fields unchanged.
